reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Goblet cell intestinal metaplasia defines Barrett oesophagus
Progressive solid to liquid dysphagia with weight loss means oesophageal cancer until excluded
Every gastric ulcer needs biopsy; duodenal ulcers almost never malign
Signet ring diffuse cancer with linitis plastica follows E cadherin loss
reference.pathophysiology: Refluxed acid and bile injure squamous oesophagus whose repair metaplasias into intestinal epithelium adapted to acid but primed for dysplasia. Helicobacter urease inflammation drives duodenal ulceration through acid load and gastric intestinal metaplasia sequences toward cancer, while prostaglandin loss removes mucus bicarbonate defence in NSAID injury.
additionalDifferentials: Gastric versus duodenal ulcer malignancy rules
Intestinal versus diffuse Lauren gastric cancers
additionalInvestigations: Endoscopy with systematic Barrett segment biopsies
Helicobacter urea breath, stool antigen or biopsy testing
CT and endoscopic ultrasound staging for cancers
